comment: Cross-zone edges only; intra-zone edges live in the zone files. finite_instance_of: a finite verified computation instantiates an infinite family, i.e. it realises at bounded parameters exactly the predicate that family quantifies without bound. depends_on_open: the target is the CLOSEST EXISTING node bearing on the source's named open antecedent - either a producer that realises it only at bounded parameters, or the node that proves the antecedent equivalent to a named open endpoint, so that no producer weaker than the open problem can exist. The basis says which; a depends_on_open edge is never a claim that the antecedent is discharged. Conditional nodes whose antecedent has no producer anywhere are listed under no_producer rather than given a spurious edge. No edge here records Lean proof dependency.
